about_the_game:
Step into Hypercycle Redux, a high-speed multiplayer arena where precision, strategy, and reflexes collide. Pilot your neon-infused bike through radiant cyber arenas, leaving behind glowing trails that are more than just a spectacle, they’re your ultimate weapon. Outsmart your opponents, trap them in narrow lanes, and fight for supremacy in intense PvP battles. Whether it’s 1v1 duels, chaotic 1v3 skirmishes, or adrenaline-fueled 1v7 showdowns, every match keeps you on the edge of your seat. Jump, ride walls, and use power-ups to turn the tide in your favor. Rack up points with daring kills, avoid death, and climb the leaderboard to cement your legacy as the top cyber rider.

Features:

  • Fast-paced multiplayer PvP: 2, 4, or 8-player battles for all skill levels

  • Strategic light trails: Use your trail to trap opponents or control the arena

  • Dynamic abilities: Jump, ride walls, and deploy power-ups to gain the upper hand

  • Highly competitive: Fun to play casually, but every match is a test of skill

  • Neon cyber arenas: Stunning visuals with glowing, futuristic tracks

  • Controller support: Experience smooth, responsive gameplay on PC

Whether you’re a motorcycle enthusiast, a tactical thinker, or a lover of fast, addictive multiplayer games, Hypercycle Redux delivers the ultimate racing-combat experience. Grab your bike, hit the grid, and prove you’ve got what it takes to dominate the arena. Are you ready to outmaneuver, outsmart, and outlast? Add to your wishlist now and join the fight!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • VR Support: no
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT (8GB VRAM)
  • VR Support: no
